The causal chain אכילת שבת → מאור עינים → שביעה → ברכת הימים is a directed eitza flow, not a family of parallel aspects.

4. STRUCTURAL NOTE: Torah #276 is one of the shortest Torahs in Likutay Moharan (3 paragraphs, ~200 words). Its purpose is to illuminate a single practical insight (why we eat three Shabbat meals — not for personal satiety but to bless the weekdays) through a tightly reasoned causal argument. It does not contain the multi-domain bechina architecture that generates packages. This Torah would appear in the graph solely through its eitza edge(s) and through shared concept-nodes that link it to other Torahs where those same concepts (שבת, מאור עינים, שביעה) have richer bechina treatments.
